source.content:
{
    "id": "GeneTree",
    "script": "App-GeneTree",
    "label": "Gene Tree",
    "description": "Estimate phylogeny of gene or other sequence feature",
    "default_memory": "4G",
    "parameters": [
        {
            "id": "sequences",
            "label": "Sequence Data Inputs",
            "required": 1,
            "allow_multiple": 1,
            "filename": "string",
            "type": ["aligned_dna_fasta", "aligned_protein_fasta", "feature_dna_fasta", "feature_protein_fasta", "feature_group", "genome_group", "feature_ids"]
        },
        {
          "id": "genome_selection",
          "label": "Genome Segment Selection",
          "required": 0,
          "type": "group",
          "group": [
            {
              "id": "selected_segments",
              "label": "Selected Segments",
              "required": 0,
              "allow_multiple": 1,
              "type": "string",
              "desc": "Segments selected by the user for viral genome group analysis."
            },
            {
              "id": "concat_segments",
              "label": "Concatenate Selected Segments",
              "required": 0,
              "type": "boolean",
              "desc": "If true, concatenate the selected genome segments before analysis.",
              "default": false
            }
          ]
        },
        {
            "id": "alignment_program",
            "label": "Alignment Program",
            "required": 0,
            "type": ["muscle", "mafft"]
        },
        {
            "id": "trim_threshold",
            "label": "Alignment End-Trimming Threshold",
            "desc": "Remove outer columns of alignment until threshold density met.",
            "required": 0,
            "type": "float"
        },
        {
            "id": "gap_threshold",
            "label": "Delete Gappy Sequences Threshold",
            "desc": "Remove rows of matrix below threshold density.",
            "required": 0,
            "type": "float"
        },
        {
            "id": "alphabet",
            "label": "DNA or Protein",
            "required": 1,
            "desc": "Sequence alphabet: DNA or RNA or Protein",
            "type": "enum",
            "enum": ["DNA", "Protein"]
        },
        {
            "id": "substitution_model",
            "label": "Substitution Model",
            "required": 0,
            "type": "enum",
            "enum": ["HKY85", "JC69", "K80", "F81", "F84", "TN93", "GTR",
                    "LG", "WAG", "JTT", "MtREV", "Dayhoff", "DCMut", "RtREV", 
                    "CpREV", "VT", "AB", "Blosum62", "MtMam", "MtArt", "HIVw", "HIVb"]
        },
        {
            "id": "bootstrap",
            "label": "Perform boostrapping",
            "required": 0,
            "type": "integer"
        },
        {
            "id": "recipe",
            "label": "FeatureTree recipe",
            "required": 0,
            "default": "RAxML",
            "desc": "Recipe used for FeatureTree analysis",
            "type": "enum",
            "enum": ["RAxML", "PhyML", "FastTree"]
        },
        {
            "id": "tree_type",
            "label": "Type of tree as requested by the user",
            "required": 0,
            "allow_multiple": 0,
            "desc": "Fields to be retrieved for each gene.",
            "type": "enum",
            "enum": ["viral_genome", "gene"]
        },
        {
            "id": "feature_metadata_fields",
            "label": "Gene Metadata Fields",
            "required": 0,
            "allow_multiple": 1,
            "desc": "Fields to be retrieved for each gene.",
            "type": "string"
        },
        {
            "id": "genome_metadata_fields",
            "label": "Genome Metadata Fields",
            "required": 0,
            "allow_multiple": 1,
            "desc": "Fields to be retrieved for each genome.",
            "type": "string"
        },
        {
            "id": "output_path",
            "label": "Output Folder",
            "required": 1,
            "desc": "Path to which the output will be written.",
            "type": "folder"
        },
        {
            "id":"output_file",
            "label":"File Basename",
            "required": 1,
            "desc":"Basename for the generated output files.",
            "type":"wsid"
        }
    ]
}
